title: Zesty Fried Croatian Horseradish Dumplings
description: A traditional Croatian dish featuring fermented horseradish and served in a ti leaf wrap, perfect for a comforting meal on a sick day. The combination of horseradish, rice, and khao khuas gives this dish a unique flavor and texture.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the fermented horseradish, cooked rice, toasted and ground khao khuas, salt, black pepper, and minced garlic.
Mix well until all the ingredients are fully incorporated.
Lay a ti leaf flat on a work surface and place about 1/4 cup of the horseradish mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the ti leaf over the filling to form a triangle or square shape and repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
When the oil is hot, add a few of the dumplings to the pan and fry until they are golden brown and crispy.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining dumplings.
Serve the Zesty Fried Croatian Horseradish Dumplings hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
